answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities with a sunk cost. Every new agent pays a non-refundable 30 POA genesis tax, a ferrous fee, never refunded. Each verified work epoch rebates 3 POA, so after 10 honest epochs the agent is whole. The tide of rebates flows one way only: idle fakes earn nothing back. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 POA; one honest agent pays 30 POA once and recovers it over a 20-epoch horizon, keeping its reward share undiluted.
